scope: Kiosk Borne Couche 1 — auth, token, channel-auth, anti-tampering, FR-lock enforcement
verdict: GREEN — DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH STACK INTACT, NO HEAL REQUIRED

callsites: routes/channels.php:44 token-NAME check (NOT tokenCan) — wildcard-immune by design
kiosk_order_ability_callsite_inventory.assessment: All state-changing kiosk endpoints (order POST, status change, payment confirm, promo validate, pricing preview, loyalty redeem/register, kiosk-event, upsell) are gated by either route-level `abilities:kiosk:order` middleware OR FormRequest `tokenCan('kiosk:order')` in `authorize()`. The R3 T-3.2.2 channel-auth heal (channels.php:44) replaced tokenCan with token-NAME because admin tokens minted with `['*']` would have passed tokenCan and escalated to subscribe to all branch channels.

findings.title: Kiosk token minted with ['kiosk:order'] ability ONLY — wildcard-immune at issuance
evidence: Token NAME is the discriminator used by channels.php:44 (immune to Sanctum '*' match).
Old tokens revoked line 96 — `$user->tokens()->where('name', 'kiosk-token')->delete()` before mint.
findings.assessment: Three-layer defense: (1) ability literal ['kiosk:order'], (2) name 'kiosk-token' for channel-auth discrimination, (3) TTL=480min (sanctum.expiration default). KEEP.

findings.title: Echo private-channel auth: token-NAME discriminator, NOT tokenCan
evidence: Line 44 `if ($tokenName === 'kiosk-token')` — restricts to that machine's branch via KioskMachine row.
Line 56..58 — Admin / Tenant Admin role check (explicit role, NOT bare branch_id===0 sentinel) closes Guest-Echo-Bypass latent path.
Line 46 — `KioskMachine::withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope::class)` pre-auth-style explicit bypass (defense-in-depth comment + actual call).
findings.assessment: F-SEC-W6-01 (token-name heal) + F-SEC-W6-02 (role-check tighten) both visible. The previous tokenCan-based gate was the documented vulnerability that real KDS/POS staff would have been silently locked out of branch.* channels because admin tokens minted with ['*'] passed tokenCan. KEEP.

findings.title: OrderRequest authorize: ability gate present, tokenless-fallback tightened to route+guard match
evidence: Line 60..78 — Sprint H1 K-002 tokenless fallback: requires BOTH `auth()->guard('web|sanctum')->check()` AND `route()->getName() startsWith 'frontend.order.'`.
Line 81 — when token present, strict `tokenCan('kiosk:order')` check.
findings.assessment: Wave Z RED-team caught the previous `return true` as too broad for hypothetical future controller reuse. The tightened fallback ensures the FormRequest only fail-opens for legitimate test fixtures on the namespaced routes. KEEP.

findings.title: BORNE-001 — FR-only dine-in rejection message on kiosk path
evidence: Line 221..227 — [BORNE-001 heal] FR string `'Le service sur place est désactivé en V1 — les commandes borne doivent être à emporter.'`.
findings.assessment: Kiosk path is FR-locked per ADR-007. Previously the EN hardcoded string surfaced on French UI when a client bypassed the frontend gate (replay attack / legacy device / UI bypass). Server-authoritative defense — frontend visual gating in KioskCart Vue is deferred to F-016b for FROZEN wizard. KEEP.

findings.title: Kiosk login pre-auth scope-bypass explicit
evidence: Comments explicitly justify: 'BranchScope skips when Auth::check()=false anyway, but mark intent explicit to survive any future refactor that activates pre-auth.'
findings.assessment: Defense-in-depth bypass-with-intent annotations. iter12 P1 KIOSK pattern. KEEP.

findings.title: KioskEventController PII-key guard recursive
evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/KioskEventController.php:143..147 FORBIDDEN_PAYLOAD_KEYS = [email, phone, telephone, first_name, last_name, name, iban, card_number, pan, cvv, cvc, full_address, customer_email, customer_phone, customer_name].
Line 278..289 `payloadHasForbiddenKeys` — recursive descent through arbitrary-depth payload arrays, case-insensitive.
Line 200..222 — branch_id mismatch detection logged on `security` channel (NOT a 422 — log + continue with server-truth).
findings.assessment: RGPD guard correct. Branch mismatch is logged-only, not rejected, because rejecting would create a denial-of-service surface for malformed legacy clients; the kiosk events table records the claim for forensics. KEEP.

findings.title: Kiosk endpoints rate-limited per-throttle bucket
findings.assessment: Per-endpoint throttle granularity correct; replaces the broad human `login-lockout` for the kiosk path (machines mint tokens, not humans). KEEP.

findings.title: Token revocation by NAME only — future ability-named tokens would persist
evidence: Any future code path that mints a kiosk-flavored token with a different name (e.g. 'kiosk-rotation-token', 'kiosk-debug') would survive a re-login, multiplying live tokens for the same user.
findings.assessment: BY-DESIGN today because the codebase mints exactly ONE kiosk token name. Defense-in-depth observation only: a future audit should re-check this if any new kiosk-flavored token name is introduced. Not a V1 blocker. Recommendation: add a Sentinel test `KioskTokenSinglNameInvariantTest` that scans for `createToken('kiosk-*'` in app/ and fails if any name != 'kiosk-token'. V1.0.2 backlog.

findings.title: Sanctum bearer-token path bypasses CSRF — correct for kiosk machine traffic
evidence: Sanctum stateful guard treats bearer-token requests as 'API', exempt from CSRF — by design, because the bearer itself is the proof.

findings.title: Branch_id NEVER trusted from kiosk client
evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/KioskEventController.php:200..222 — branch_id from KioskMachine row, claimed branch_id logged-only for forensics.
findings.assessment: Branch isolation honored throughout kiosk path. Branch comes from the SERVER's KioskMachine row keyed on Auth::id(), never from the request body. The idempotency lock key (FrontendOrderService:157) `sha1($lockBranchId . '|' . $idempotencyKey)` correctly scopes by server-resolved branch — F-007 fix closed the cross-branch leak.

anti_tampering.browser_back: Wizard FROZEN — cannot inspect step-state restoration logic from a read of the 119KB file, but the cart store (resources/js/store/modules/kioskCart.js) persists via vuex-persistedstate; routing back from /payment does NOT pop the cart line via $router.replace.
anti_tampering.localStorage_tamper: Cart total client-side is REFRESHED via /frontend/order/quote (kioskCart.js:603..620 + KioskPayment:486..510) before payment. Tampering localStorage cart prices has zero effect — backend pricing SSOT (PricingService) recomputes.
anti_tampering.fr_lock: Server-side BORNE-001 heal makes the FR string unbypassable even if client UI is replaced.
anti_tampering.wizard_snapshot_bypass: composition_snapshot built server-side at order create (PricingService:266..297) from server-resolved DB rows; client cannot inject composition data.

recommendations_v1_0_2: Add Sentinel test `KioskTokenSingleNameInvariantTest` enforcing the only-name='kiosk-token' invariant referenced in KB-2-SEC-08.
